_: Laws compiled to checks (50 laws, crew#108). verdict: mechanical = a machine can decide it; partial = a machine can flag a strong smell but not decide; judgement = no check, and saying so is the honest answer. 'guards' names the scripts that would run it. 'state' is live / dead / absent, cross-checked against disk by law_enforcement.py.

laws.law_title: Put the fire out first
laws.check: a numbered restoration objective was declared in an earlier turn and this reply does not reprint the number

laws.law_title: Proof before action
laws.check: reply contains a hedge (probably, likely, it must be, appears to) and the turn ran no command that could settle it

laws.law_title: Never make the same mistake twice
laws.check: Write creates a new path whose distinctive symbol never appeared in a prior Grep; a config write that no longer parses is refused

laws.law_title: Think it through before you touch it
Unblock yourself
laws.check: reply contains 'founder action' or an ask aimed at him, and no line names a blocker with Tried/Error/Need/Who

laws.law_title: Root cause, and the class of mistake
laws.check: the same problem is narrated in two consecutive replies and no command between them changed it

laws.law_title: Refresh on main before you ask for review
laws.check: git fetch origin main && test $(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main) -eq 0

laws.law_title: Fix the trap where you found it
Stay on the job
laws.check: the named job's number has not moved across three consecutive turns; a reply that does not open DONE:/INVENTORY:/WORKING:/WAITING:/BLOCKED: is refused

laws.law_title: Say it once, on the board
laws.check: an outbound peer message repeats one already on ESTATE_BOARD.jsonl; unseen board rows are handed to the session at its next prompt

laws.law_title: Never decide alone what you cannot undo alone
Root out a risk to the pipeline, do not narrate it
laws.check: gh pr create is refused past 20 live open PRs and a merge that strands another PR's base is refused; the risk is capped, not narrated

laws.law_title: Hold the platform and the stack at once
laws.check: reply to the founder carries neither a platform line nor a stack line

laws.law_title: Take the cost or speed win when you find one
Evidence must converge from two angles
laws.check: reply says proven, confirmed or verified and cites fewer than two distinct sources

laws.law_title: Leave a path back when you drop something
laws.check: the session dropped a thread and wrote no checkpoints/LATEST.md

laws.law_title: Prove it is operational before you say it is done
laws.check: reply opens with DONE and carries no Founder receipt:, or INVENTORY without Built/Use/Expect/Not done/Evidence

laws.law_title: Every founder request is a tracked item
laws.check: every founder prompt is written to the ledger; open items whose acceptance commands now exit 0 are closed

laws.law_title: Portability outranks detection
laws.check: a dependency manifest changed and no exit drill for that dependency ran green in the same PR

laws.law_title: Seamless is the deliverable
Secure by default, and prove it
laws.check: a secret-shaped value appears in a reply, a gh comment body, a handoff, a PR body, a commit or a screenshot

laws.law_title: Show the green run, do not describe it
laws.check: scripts/pr-evidence.py check --pr N: a pull request carries an image of its green run

laws.law_title: Take the smaller road when both arrive
laws.check: PR body has '## Options considered' with two real options and a Chosen: line; a reply that ends on a menu instead of a decision is refused

laws.law_title: If it is load-bearing, it is in git
laws.check: a load-bearing file differs from its tracked copy or is untracked; every provider rules file is a symlink to ~/AGENTS.md

laws.law_title: Checkpoint before you switch
laws.check: a switch command (git worktree add, checkout -b, switch -c) runs while the current issue has no checkpoint comment

laws.law_title: Crew is the sync layer
laws.check: a commit touches a shared path and references no open crew issue

laws.law_title: Make the setup need you once, then never again
laws.check: a setup step asked of the founder was already asked in an earlier session

laws.law_title: An instrument nobody reads is not an instrument
laws.check: a file under state/ has no reader in the corpus, or a live stream is silent beyond its cadence; a session with no handoff in 30 minutes is refused

laws.law_title: Attribute before you repair
laws.check: repairs shipped exceeds predictions logged and scored

laws.law_title: Experience accumulates, or it is not research
laws.check: a WebSearch/WebFetch happened and nothing was appended to the research record

laws.law_title: The founder does not run scripts
laws.check: reply to the founder contains an imperative aimed at him: run, type, execute, paste, click

laws.law_title: A feature ships with a demo and an onboarding
laws.check: a feat: commit or a new top level source directory ships without docs/demo and docs/onboarding

laws.law_title: Define done before you start, in commands
laws.check: no Bash/Edit runs without an open issue whose body carries acceptance commands; review-gate refuses a PR whose DoD boxes are not commands

laws.law_title: Provider agnostic from day 0, Claude included
laws.check: a reply, spec, ruling or plan makes a vendor-only channel mandatory

laws.law_title: Get better at getting better
Know who the platform is for
The platform is a product, not a chore
Self-service with guardrails, and a guard that refuses correct work is an outage
laws.check: every hook run lands in hook-outcomes.jsonl with its verdict; a refusal of correct work is a false_refusal row nobody yet writes

laws.law_title: Inventory every asset, or you will build it twice
Build it so it could be sold
Build for the buyer arriving tomorrow
The most capable agent works only multipliers
Never reinvent the wheel and do a worse job
laws.check: pr-evidence.py's Options-considered gate fails a PR body with no '## Options considered' naming the mature tool rejected

laws.law_title: A law without a protocol is a wish
laws.check: science/map_covers_laws.py: every law in AGENTS.md has a row here with a check or an honest judgement verdict; review-gate.yml fails closed

laws.law_title: Your mistake ends as a guard no session can walk past, proved over every instance
laws.check: a fix that closes an incident ships without a tests/test_incident_* file; a DONE without evidence is refused

laws.law_title: No hardcoding: a file never names where the checkout, the home directory or the machine lives
laws.check: a literal home directory, host, port or checkout path is typed where a lookup should be

laws.law_title: A founder blocker is loud, visible and one action: push notification plus a `FOUNDER ACTION:` line with the exact URL or word
laws.check: a reply says FOUNDER ACTION: and founder-blocker.py has not delivered it to Telegram in the last 60 minutes

laws.law_title: Continuous execution: a broken state found while answering a question is fixed in the same turn, never reported and parked
laws.check: a reply reports a P1 or broken state it found and the turn ran no command against it

laws.law_title: Lazy consensus: a safe or reversible action is done and announced `STAGED:` with a 60-minute timer, never asked
laws.check: a reply asks permission for an action the rulings mark reversible

laws.law_title: Every workload emits to the central collector, and coverage is proved by querying the backend, never by scanning files; admission refuses a workload that does not emit
laws.check: idp admission refuses a workload with no OTel exporter; coverage is a backend query, never a file scan
git fetch origin main && test $(git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/main) -eq 0
an outbound peer message repeats one already on ESTATE_BOARD.jsonl without a 'Re-raising:' line
prompt-ledger has open items whose acceptance commands now exit 0

sections.name: Plain English
sections.check: reply above the fold uses jargon, stacked dashes or a rhetorical trick

sections.name: Context discipline: one round-trip per intent
sections.check: independent tool calls issued in separate messages when one would do

sections.name: Session hygiene: resident context
sections.check: resident context crosses the auto-compact threshold with no handoff written

sections.name: Never sit and watch a long command
sections.check: a foreground command exceeded 30s that should have been backgrounded

_renumber: 2026-08-23: the founder cut 32 laws to 10 ('anything that can be automated shouldn't be a law'). A check was bound to a law by its NUMBER, so the renumber silently re-pointed every check above 2 at a different law and nothing failed. Each entry now carries `was` (the number the check was written for), `law` (the number today, null if the rule retired to a machine) and `law_title` (the heading it must still match). science/map_covers_laws.py fails when a title moves out from under a check.
